summary: Shared-student swipe-context scoring could not start: the only local context-en-de-v1 export binds the pre-alignment corpus, which provably leaks swipe-validation sessions into context training, and the canonical shared-session export is absent from this tree.

localExportChain.note: Pre-alignment student trained before commit b42af82f re-hashed shared-source sessions to the swipe split. This is not the canonical shared-session model.

canonicalExportChain.note: Two byte-identical Linux exports; artifacts are not present in this local tree. The corrected invocation uses --distillation-manifest models/context/distillation-manifest.json (file sha 72c090…) and the existing joint-model-splits-shared-v2.json audit, exactly as the small-student run did.

contaminationMeasurement.method: Mapped each swipe-validation sessionId to its context-corpus split under the pre-b42af82f hashing: context sessionId = sha256('libreboard-context-session-split-v1\0futo-swipe-dataset-v1\0' + session), swipe sessionId = sha256('libreboard-swipe-session-split-v1\0' + session), over the on-disk corpus build/model-data/context-en-de-v1 (split-manifest 63bfb4…) and source artifacts build/model-sources/futo-swipe-dataset-v1/{train,dev,test}.jsonl.
contaminationMeasurement.interpretation: Under the pre-alignment corpus, 90.0% of swipe-validation rows (74.6% of sessions) have their source session inside context-train. Scoring the local export on validation slates would be contaminated even if the audit were bypassed; no honest audit of corpus 63bfb4… can satisfy contextSplitRows.train == 0.

smallStudentResult.note: Previously undocumented committed result: every nonzero context coefficient degraded top-3 monotonically on the frozen 6k merged slates.

limitations: This file records a binding/audit failure and a session-mapping measurement, not a model-quality result.

The contamination count uses the pre-b42af82f session hash reconstructed from git history; the audit tool itself cannot certify corpus 63bfb4… because its recorded policy/tool pins differ from the current ones.
No coefficient sweep ran for the shared student; the small-student 6k result and the 1k greedy-OOV result remain the only measured context evidence.
Publisher reference prefixes are not captured prior editor input; session separation does not exclude prompt overlap.
